semiconductor_relevance: Low — Swagelok primarily provides fluid system components and services, which are not specifically tailored for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Swagelok Company specializes in fluid system applications, offering a wide range of products such as fittings, valves, and regulators. While they serve various industries including semiconductor, their offerings are more focused on fluid management rather than semiconductor-specific technologies.

regional_presence.India: Swagelok operates through two Authorized Sales and Services Centers in India, covering a broad geographical area including South India, North India, and neighboring countries.
